content:
tamir: Heads up— Orbitory (acct OB-559) queried INV-2026-109. They downgraded from Reserved-L to Reserved-S effective 2026-06-12 but were billed L for whole June. Asking for correction + any burst forgiveness.
olga: Can you attach amendment? Need effective date to prorate.
tamir: Uploaded Orbitory_AMEND_0612.pdf. Effective 2026-06-12.
billing-bot: Metering snapshot (Jun 01-30) for OB-559:
``n2026-06-01,committed_units,burst_units
2026-06-01,600000,40000
2026-06-15,600000,120000
TOTAL,600000,160000
```
amanda: Invoice INV-2026-109 lines: 
Line1: RSRV-L-2026, qty1, period 2026-06-01-30, amt $11,000
Line2: OVG-TOK, 160,000 tokens, amt $960
Total $11,960
fin_ops: Pricing: RSRV-L $11k/mo, RSRV-S $6k/mo. Proration: 11 days at L (Jun1-11), 19 days at S (Jun12-30). Daily L=11000/30=366.67, daily S=6000/30=200. New reserved = 11*366.67 + 19*200 = 4,033.37 + 3,800 = $7,833.37 -> reserved delta = 11,000 - 7,833.37 = $3,166.63.
ryan: AM promised a one-time 50k token waiver during migration. Overage rate = $0.006/token -> 50k * 0.006 = $300.
olga: Suggest credit = $3,166.63 + $300 = $3,466.63. Under $5k so approver not required but please note manager FYI.
amanda: Drafting credit memo CM-2026-019 for $3,466.63, reason "proration per executed amendment + one-time migration waiver".
fin_ops: No SLA breaches flagged for OB-559 in June.
ryan: Confirm waiver non-recurring.
olga: Confirmed. Applying credit and reissuing invoice INV-2026-109-R1. Notifying customer.
tamir: Customer acked receipt and said they will reconcile. Logging under BILL-2026-378. Closing thread.
